# iPhone Duo capability rows — draft

Prepared November 4, 2026 from `main` at commit 1fb8050, for owner review.

**Draft: none of these rows is approved.** They are not in `content/product.json`, and no landing page references them. Their only source is the iOS 2.5.0 release notes (commit 086f93e, generated by `tools/release/promote.sh` and marked "review the wording before merging"). Release notes are not device QA.

Approval follows the same path as [capability-approval.md](capability-approval.md): the owner records an exact confirmation, and each row moves to `verified` only with the owner's approval date, the app version tested, and its evidence.

## Proposed rows

| Claim ID | Proposed capability | Platform | Proposed tier | Conditions / boundary | Open question |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| duo-two-page-ios | Two-page facing spread on the iPhone Duo inner display for EPUB and PDF | ios | free | Inner display, open book. iOS 2.5.0 or later | Confirm EPUB and PDF spreads are free |
| duo-comics-ios | Facing pages and Panel Mode for comics on the iPhone Duo | ios | pending-decision | Outer display, flat inner display or folded Duo | Free preview or Pro? Full CBZ is Pro today |
| duo-fold-layout-ios | Fold-aware Library grid, reader controls and layout on the iPhone Duo | ios | free | Seated pose, half-fold and Split View. iPhone and iPad unchanged | Confirm tier and the listed postures |
| duo-min-version-ios | iPhone Duo support starts in Sutra 2.5.0 for iOS | ios | not-applicable | Earlier versions do not include Duo support | Confirm the minimum version on device |

## Source copy

- index.html Features table, Reading group: "iPhone Duo support — iOS only", with EPUB & PDF in the Free column and Yes in the Sutra Pro column. The Pro cell depends on the tier decision for duo-comics-ios.
- help.html, iPhone Duo section, and iphone-duo.html (both from the iOS 2.5.0 release notes).
